Suppose that $x\in M_T$ so that $\tau _1=0$. Then \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial \tau }\widetilde l(Z,\tau )=-\frac{K^\tau (\gamma _Z)}{2\tau ^{\frac{3}{2}}}. \]

Proof

\sketch ↗ lem:reduced-length-tangential-tau-derivative ↗ lem:reduced-length-k-formula This is immediate from Lemma lem:reduced-length-tangential-tau-derivative and Lemma lem:reduced-length-k-formula (after the latter is rewritten using $\widetilde L$ instead of $L_x$).

□
